announcements.headline: Proact introduces new financial targets for 2030
announcements.insight: Proact introduces new financial targets for 2030. This follows recent leadership appointments and a share repurchase programme.

announcements.insight: The Nomination Committee appointment is a standard governance step for the upcoming Annual General Meeting. Shareholders should monitor subsequent proxy materials for voting details.

announcements.headline: Jacob Kronborg appointed Business Unit Director for Central
announcements.insight: Jacob Kronborg’s appointment as Business Unit Director for Central represents a board-level change. This follows recent executive appointments and financial updates.

announcements.insight: The board change in August supports the new share repurchase programme announced following the interim report. Shareholders should monitor execution details.

announcements.insight: Åsa Regen Jansson appointed CFO. This follows the interim report showing growth and improved profitability in a volatile market.
